sections.title: Plural colours
sections.content: When the clothes are the subject and the colour comes after them, the colour agrees in number. A plural subject takes a plural colour, with *-k*: *A cipők feketék.* (The shoes are black.) Vowels lengthen or link as for nouns: *fekete → feketék*, *szürke → szürkék*, *barna → barnák*, but *fehér → fehérek* and *színes → színesek*.

items.spanish: A sapkák barnák, a kabátok kékek.
items.english: The hats are brown, the coats are blue.

sections.content: Compare *szürke zokni* (adjective in front, no ending) with *A zoknik szürkék* (colour after the noun, with *-k*).
